items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So one summer, a long time ago, I got a call from Michael Cuscuna. Their Japanese arm of Blue Note wanted to re-issue all the masters.

ctx.x: So maybe you can talk a little bit about how the RVG series got started.

So one summer, a long time ago, I got a call from Michael Cuscuna. Their Japanese arm of Blue Note wanted to re-issue all the masters. So a fellow by the name of Namikata decided to launch a series of RVG re-masters. First they agreed, the people who owned the tapes here, and that began a whole long process of which I made a couple of hundred or re-masters of their catalogue. And that sort of reawakened everything that was going on here, the music was going down, and then that started going up. I was doing small…
